data.name: Aura of Preservation
data.description: A forest preserver grants animals and plants within 10 feet spell resistance %1. This spell resistance doesn't apply against harmless effects created by the forest preserver or allies within 10 feet of her. This ability functions only if the forest preserver is conscious.|11+PaladinLVL
